function.name: index_websites
function.description: Crawl and index websites into DuckDB. Use the "sites" parameter to specify which websites to index.

sites.description: Comma-separated list of website URLs to index (e.g. "https://example.com, https://other.org"). If omitted, uses configured website URLs.

function.name: reindex_websites
function.description: Rebuild the website index. Use the "sites" parameter to specify which websites to reindex.

sites.description: Comma-separated list of website URLs to reindex (e.g. "https://example.com, https://other.org"). If omitted, uses configured website URLs.

function.name: purge_stale_index
function.description: Delete indexed website rows that no longer belong to currently configured seed URLs.

function.name: search_indexed_websites
function.description: Search indexed website content with hybrid semantic ranking.

function.name: get_indexed_page
function.description: Get full stored content for one indexed URL.
